rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` has the `name: habeas` front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement says each link to a file of specialized material must say when to read it. The file has two such links, and each one does:

- `references/distributed-requirements.md` is introduced with "For an obligation that applies separately at each of many sites… read [it] before drafting it, and whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`." This says when to read it.
- `references/syntax-details.md` is introduced with "If a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment, such as a shipped skill or a stylesheet copied into other projects, or a requirement lives in a nested chapter, read [it]." This says when to read it.

The mention of `references/fixme.md` is plain code text, not a link. It sits in a parenthetical about the habeas-evidence skill, so it falls outside the "link" obligation. The other skills are named without links. The site has no gap.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
